items.headline: Singapore bars ex-Megaspeed CEO Alice Huang and keeps six others under probe in the Nvidia chip saga
items.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs said on 12 November that Alice Huang was given a stern warning and barred from re-entering Singapore for giving police information she knew to be inaccurate to downplay her role at data-centre firm Megaspeed.

items.headline: PM Wong joins the ASEAN summit in Manila as Trump presses the bloc on his 'Pax Silica' chip plan
items.summary: PM Lawrence Wong is in Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit from 15 November; Trump will push Southeast Asian states to join his Pax Silica AI chip-supply initiative. Singapore takes over the ASEAN chair in 2027.

items.headline: Cyclist, 24, killed in Changi collision with a tipper truck, Singapore's second fatal cycling crash in a day
items.summary: A 24-year-old male cyclist died after colliding with a tipper truck in Changi on 12 November, the second fatal cyclist accident within about 24 hours.

items.headline: Man, 32, from China charged with repeatedly trying to bribe ICA officers to enter Singapore
items.summary: A 32-year-old Chinese national allegedly tried on multiple occasions to bribe ICA officers and airport staff to gain entry into Singapore.

items.headline: Yes Bank asks India's Supreme Court to review a ruling reviving US$893 million in written-down bonds
items.summary: Yes Bank filed on 14 November for a review of the Supreme Court's 15 October judgment, which set aside the 2020 permanent write-down of its Additional Tier 1 bonds.

items.headline: Modi ally Chandrababu Naidu warns India's growth is not keeping pace with young people's expectations
items.summary: Andhra Pradesh CM N. Chandrababu Naidu, a key Modi coalition partner, said growth is 'visible, but not enough' to meet rising expectations, especially among the young.

items.headline: India's US$5.4 trillion equity market rebounds, brightening the outlook for exchanges and brokerages
items.summary: Indian stocks are recovering after sliding to an 18-month low, with renewed foreign inflows lifting the outlook for exchanges and brokerages.

items.headline: India and the US say a trade deal could be signed in December as tariff talks 'largely conclude'
items.summary: India and the US could sign a trade agreement at the December G20 summit, with Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal saying talks have largely concluded; a February deal cut US tariffs on India to 18%.

items.headline: UK PM Burnham plays down his own talk of rejoining the EU, insisting 'no one's talking about rejoining'
items.summary: PM Andy Burnham sought on 14 November to quiet speculation from his own remarks on closer EU ties, ahead of a UK-EU summit in Brussels on 20 November.

items.headline: Burnham warns of 'long nights ahead' as a UK-EU summit looms in Brussels
items.summary: Ahead of the 20 November UK-EU summit, Burnham warned of difficult negotiations over a closer post-Brexit relationship amid cabinet divisions.

items.headline: Burnham commits to unveiling his 10-year plan for Britain before the Christmas recess
items.summary: The PM said his long-promised 10-year plan will be published before Parliament's Christmas recess, after hints it could slip into the new year.

items.headline: At COP31, Burnham reaffirms Britain's 2050 net-zero target and backs a global electrification push
items.summary: At COP31 in Antalya, Burnham recommitted the UK to net zero by 2050 and backed Turkey's electrification pledge as the US again stayed away.

items.headline: Update: Ukraine rejects a US-floated 'Donbas for NATO' trade as Abu Dhabi talks yield only a prisoner swap
items.summary: Zelenskyy said US mediators asked whether Ukraine would withdraw from Donbas for NATO membership, and he refused; the sides agreed a prisoner exchange but no path to ending the war.

items.headline: Russia and Ukraine trade heavy overnight strikes even as the US diplomatic push continues
items.summary: Russia said it intercepted 1,198 Ukrainian drones overnight across 15+ regions, while a Ukrainian strike in Belgorod killed a family of three.

items.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital kills six, including a surgeon and a 13-year-old boy
items.summary: Palestinian officials said an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital's surgical unit on 12 November killed six and wounded about 40; Israel said it targeted a Hamas commander, a claim staff rejected.

items.headline: EU demands Israel grant 'immediate, unimpeded' aid access to Gaza as winter floods deepen the crisis
items.summary: The EU urged Israel on 14 November to reopen all Gaza crossings and let aid in, after rain affected at least 106,000 people per UNICEF.

items.headline: Update: Nvidia's US$10 billion Anthropic share pledge comes under scrutiny as the IPO nears
items.summary: An amended prospectus shows Nvidia agreed to buy about US$10 billion more of Anthropic stock after the offering; Anthropic plans to list on Nasdaq as 'ANT' around 19 November.

items.headline: Two major investors urge Nvidia's board to consider bringing back Jensen Huang
items.summary: Two large Nvidia shareholders wrote to the board asking it to weigh Huang's return, days after he resigned; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO.

items.headline: Researchers say China's top open AI models bear fingerprints of export-banned Nvidia chips
items.summary: Analysis claims DeepSeek's V4 and Moonshot's Kimi K3 show signs of training on restricted Nvidia Blackwell chips; US lawmakers are opening a probe into chip-export approvals.

items.headline: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open-source AI after Jensen Huang's exit
items.summary: Clement Delangue said Hugging Face will keep championing open-source models; Nvidia's US$12.9 billion deal to buy the platform is under DOJ antitrust review.

items.headline: Apple's market value tops US$5.2 trillion as investors seek shelter from the AI selloff
items.summary: Apple set an intraday record on 13 November, topping US$5.2 trillion in market value, as money rotated out of AI chipmakers; the Nasdaq still logged its best week since August.

items.headline: Cerebras rallies after a surprise quarterly profit and a new Microsoft deal
items.summary: AI-chip maker Cerebras jumped after reporting an unexpected Q3 profit and announcing a new agreement with Microsoft.

items.headline: Modine shares jump about 25% on a report that Samsung is weighing an acquisition
items.summary: Thermal-management firm Modine surged roughly 25% on 13 November after reports Samsung Electronics is in talks to buy it.

items.headline: US October producer prices rise 0.3%, cooler than expected, easing inflation worries
items.summary: October PPI rose 0.3% month over month, below the 0.4% consensus, helping futures open higher and tempering inflation fears.

items.headline: 🎾 ATP Finals begin in Turin without injured defending champion Jannik Sinner
items.summary: The Nitto ATP Finals opened in Turin on 15 November, with world No. 1 Zverev facing Jodar and Alcaraz starting Monday; Sinner misses the event with a knee injury.

items.headline: 🎾 Svitolina, Andreeva, Pegula and Noskova reach the WTA Finals semifinals in Indian Wells
items.summary: Svitolina beat Sabalenka 6-3, 3-6, 6-1 to join Andreeva, Pegula and Noskova in the last four at the US$10m WTA Finals in Indian Wells; the title is decided this weekend.

items.headline: 🏏 India aim to seal the ODI series against New Zealand in the Mount Maunganui decider
items.summary: India lead 2-1 and meet New Zealand in the final ODI at Bay Oval on 15 November, days after Matt Henry's 6-27 and Will Young's century drove a 244-run win.

items.headline: 🏎️ With Antonelli's title sealed, Mercedes and Ferrari take their constructors' fight into F1's final triple-header
items.summary: Antonelli has wrapped up the drivers' title as F1's youngest champion, so the live battle into Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi is the constructors' crown, where Mercedes lead Ferrari.

items.headline: Intellia's in-body CRISPR therapy nears what could be the first FDA approval for editing genes inside the body
items.summary: Intellia's lonvo-z edits genes directly inside the body and could be the first such CRISPR medicine, with an FDA decision expected by 10 March; a phase 3 trial cut attacks 87%.

items.headline: Astronomers spot an invisible object that may be a rare supermassive neutron star
items.summary: A red giant appears to orbit a dark companion; researchers think it is most likely a neutron star heavier than theory usually allows, though a black hole remains possible.

items.headline: Eli Lilly's daily weight-loss pill sharply reduces sleep-apnea severity in a trial
items.summary: Eli Lilly's oral GLP-1 drug orforglipron (Foundayo) cut obstructive sleep-apnea severity by about 27.5% in overweight or obese participants; an FDA filing is planned before year-end.

items.headline: Forecasters warn the strengthening El Nino could be the strongest on record
items.summary: The El Nino building in the Pacific is on track to be the largest in at least 150 years, with a 90%+ chance it surpasses every event since the 1870s, raising extreme-weather risks.

fun_fact.headline: Most 'wasabi' outside Japan is dyed horseradish, not real wasabi
fun_fact.body: Most 'wasabi' served outside Japan is not wasabi but a dyed paste of horseradish and mustard; real Wasabia japonica is hard to grow and loses its pungency within ~15 minutes of grating.

puzzle.title: Photo Finish
puzzle.body: Four runners (Ava, Ben, Cara, Dan) finished 1-4. (1) Ava finished exactly one place behind Dan. (2) Cara finished ahead of Dan. (3) Ben did not finish in the top three. Find the order.
puzzle.approach: Fix who must be last first, then use the one-place-behind clue.

word_puzzle.title: Corner to Corner
word_puzzle.body: Letter Boxed. Top D O R, Left I M E, Right P A K, Bottom L T S. Solve in two words using all 12 letters.
word_puzzle.approach: Chain two words covering all 12 letters; no two letters from the same side in a row.

notes: India ran on fallback sources (Bloomberg, CNBC) because all primary India outlets (The Hindu, Indian Express, Hindustan Times, Times of India, NDTV, Economic Times) were unreachable from the routine network. UK ran on fallback source (Bloomberg) because primary UK outlets (BBC, Sky News) were unreachable. 3 retry attempts were made per section before falling back. F1 is inter-race (Las Vegas GP is 21 Nov); drivers' title already clinched by Antonelli, so the item covers the constructors' fight. WTA Finals semifinals/final fall after the routine's compute time, so that item reports the confirmed semifinal line-up. Markets last closed Friday 13 Nov (weekend), so Business items avoid the already-published weekly close.
